title: RouteBindingLedger
description:
The subscribing repository's OWN claims about which frame draws which route.

A ledger under VDS S-4(2): generated, digest-witnessed, byte-reproducible by the named command. Supplied by the subject and never derived here, for the reason [`super::RouteManifest`] is supplied: which artefact in the estate speaks for a route binding is the estate's question, and VDS deciding it would make VDS the authority on the estate's own record.

It holds routes and node IDS and nothing else. Neither is a design value.

source.description: The artefact the claims were read FROM, in the estate's own words.

RouteBinding.description: One claim, made by some artefact in the subscribing repository, that a route is drawn by a node.

claimedAt.description: Where the claim is made, so a reader can open it and see for themselves. VDS does not decide which claim is true; it names both.

Timestamp.description: UTC, second resolution, trailing Z. The one canonical form VDS writes.
